Name: Willy's Fishing Workshops
Author: not4bene
Description:
[size=5][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.

[/list][size=5][b]How to use[/b][/size]
Visit the Beach after you have received a letter from Willy and seen his introduction scene. Then, you will be introduced to his Workshops.

This mod allows you to train your fishing game without consequeces. Buy Workshop Ticket, choose specific or random fish and reel in you rod!
While you practice:
[list]
[*]you won't keep caught fish
[*]your equipment won't wear out
[*]you will gain NO fishing experience points
[/list]This mod is here solely to improve your fishing game skills. Enjoy!
[b][size=4]
Requirements[/size][/b]
[list]

[*][size=2]SMAPI 4.0.8[/size]
[/list]
